segments.text: This is the eighth and final video presentation for the case animal and plant biotechnology course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动物与植物生物技术课程的第八个，也是最后一个视频讲解。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information. Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: Moving research into production. Lesson 5.2 from lab to production.
segments.zh: 把研究推向生产。第 5.2 课　从实验室到生产。

segments.text: You completed project 5.2.2 regulatory roundup, during which you determine the influence of governmental regulatory agencies in biotechnology application safety.
segments.zh: 你已经完成了项目 5.2.2“法规综述”，其间你确定了政府监管机构对生物技术应用安全的影响。

segments.text: This presentation provides information about the steps and processes involved in bringing a new biotechnology application to fruition.
segments.zh: 本讲解介绍让一项新的生物技术应用最终落地所涉及的步骤和流程。

segments.text: Moving a new discovery from research into production requires a great deal of time, testing, and trials.
segments.zh: 把一项新发现从研究推向生产，需要大量的时间、检测和试验。

segments.text: There are many phases to test the reliability of the products and the possible effects it may have when produced.
segments.zh: 有许多阶段用来检验产品的可靠性，以及产品投产后可能带来的影响。

segments.text: Critical stages include manufacturing, risk analysis, regulation, and testing.
segments.zh: 关键阶段包括生产制造、风险分析、监管和检测。

segments.text: Good manufacturing practices are a set of standards that are enforced by the FDA.
segments.zh: 良好生产规范是由 FDA 强制执行的一套标准。

segments.text: GMPs ensure that safe practices are used throughout the production process and that all materials are of high quality grade.
segments.zh: GMP 确保在整个生产过程中采用安全的做法，并且所有材料都具有高质量等级。

segments.text: Workers must follow proper laboratory practices, facilities must be maintained, and formal processes for developing and testing must be followed.
segments.zh: 工作人员必须遵守正确的实验室规范，设施必须得到维护，开发和检测必须遵循正式的流程。

segments.text: All products must be demonstrated to be of consistent quality and form.
segments.zh: 所有产品都必须证明其质量和形态始终如一。

segments.text: Risk analysis is used to determine how safe a new technology is and how it should be monitored.
segments.zh: 风险分析用来确定一项新技术有多安全，以及应如何对其进行监测。

segments.text: All risks are weighed, measured, and evaluated against the potential benefits of the technology.
segments.zh: 所有风险都要与该技术的潜在益处进行权衡、衡量和评估。

segments.text: Questions and considerations for a risk analysis differ based on the organism being modified and the product desired.
segments.zh: 风险分析需要考虑的问题和因素，取决于被改造的生物体和所需的产品而有所不同。

segments.text: Considerations when conducting a risk analysis include resistance, negative characteristics, target species, impacts, health effects, non-target species impacts, and potential for transfer.
segments.zh: 进行风险分析时需要考虑的因素包括抗性、不良性状、对靶标物种的影响、健康影响、对非靶标物种的影响以及转移的可能性。

segments.text: Potential threats or risks are categorized according to many factors.
segments.zh: 潜在的威胁或风险要根据许多因素进行分类。

segments.text: Products with low levels of transferability and reversible effects require less monitoring than those with high levels of transferability and irreversible effects.
segments.zh: 可转移性低、影响可逆的产品，比可转移性高、影响不可逆的产品所需的监测要少。

segments.text: The index of risk takes into account the damage, exposure, and precedent.
segments.zh: 风险指数考虑了损害、暴露和先例。

segments.text: Damage is the level or intensity of the impact that the GMP could have on the system.
segments.zh: 损害是指转基因植物可能对系统造成的影响程度或强度，

segments.text: If the proposed adverse effect actually occurs.
segments.zh: 前提是所设想的不良影响确实发生了。

segments.text: Exposure related to the level that some component, for example soil, animal, native plant, is exposed to the damage.
segments.zh: 暴露是指某个组成部分，例如土壤、动物、本地植物，暴露于该损害的程度。

segments.text: The higher the exposure, the higher the possibility of an adverse effect occurring.
segments.zh: 暴露程度越高，发生不良影响的可能性就越大。

segments.text: Presence event considers the previous occurrence of the adverse effect as a consequence of the event in question.
segments.zh: 先例考虑的是，此前是否发生过由所讨论事件导致的这种不良影响。

segments.text: The index of significance takes into account the extent and reversibility and includes the location where the GMP will be cultivated.
segments.zh: 显著性指数考虑了影响范围和可逆性，并包括转基因植物将要种植的地点。

segments.text: The identification and evaluation of the potential adverse effects and the evaluation of the current environmental situation.
segments.zh: 也就是对潜在不良影响的识别和评估，以及对当前环境状况的评估。

segments.text: Extent reflects the extent of dispersal or the distribution of the damage.
segments.zh: 范围反映的是损害扩散的程度或分布范围。

segments.text: Reversibility is the ability of the system to return to the previous condition.
segments.zh: 可逆性是指系统恢复到原先状态的能力。

segments.text: Regulatory agencies studied in the previous activity play big roles in the process involved in bringing new biotechnologies to the marketplace.
segments.zh: 在上一个活动中学习过的监管机构，在把新生物技术推向市场的过程中发挥着重要作用。

segments.text: Products must undergo extensive testing in order to determine the reliability of the results and all potential effects, side effects, and other outcomes.
segments.zh: 产品必须经过大量检测，以确定结果的可靠性以及所有潜在影响、副作用和其他后果。

segments.text: If lab testing has positive results, the product may move into limited field testing.
segments.zh: 如果实验室检测结果良好，产品就可以进入有限的田间试验。

segments.text: As a review, mark or highlight three key points in your notes that are important to remember from this presentation.
segments.zh: 作为复习，请在笔记中标出或突出本讲解中需要记住的三个要点。

segments.text: List two ideas or concepts that relate to previous knowledge.
segments.zh: 列出两个与已有知识相关的观点或概念。

segments.text: List any questions you have about this topic.
segments.zh: 列出你对这个主题的任何问题。

segments.text: Discuss these questions with your instructor.
segments.zh: 并与老师讨论这些问题。

segments.text: Keep any notes you have from this presentation organized and available for use throughout the course.
segments.zh: 把本讲解的所有笔记整理好，以便在整个课程中随时使用。

segments.text: Through Project 5.2.3 Making Research a Reality, you will develop a model depicting the steps from laboratory research through production of end use of the biotechnology.
segments.zh: 通过项目 5.2.3“让研究成为现实”，你将建立一个模型，描绘生物技术从实验室研究到生产再到最终使用的各个步骤。

segments.text: This will help you demonstrate how results of research have to undergo multiple steps in trials before reaching consumers.
segments.zh: 这将帮助你展示研究成果在到达消费者手中之前，必须经过多个步骤的试验。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide more instructions and expectations for the product, along with Project 5.2.3 Evaluation Rubric.
segments.zh: 你的老师会提供关于该项目的更多说明和要求，以及项目 5.2.3 的评分标准。
